messages:
Ravi: Mini update 

Ravi: Hosting an 'Indie Brawl & Couch Camp' tonight 7pm in the game-room. Bring controllers, local co-op games, and patience for chaotic button-mashing.
Nina: I'll bring my Switch + Mario Kart + Smash for guaranteed mayhem.
Sam: I can bring a PS4 controller and a RetroPie Pi with a bunch of classics (legal backups only) :wink: 
Olga: I have an HDMI capture dongle if anyone wants to snag short clips for the socials.
Ravi: Also can someone bring an extra ethernet cable? Our Wi-Fi tends to choke when 6+ devices stream at once.
Nina: 10ft Cat6 here, bringing it.
Sam: Snack plan: chips + soda on me. Any allergies/dietary restrictions?
Olga: Please no peanuts, allergic. I'll bring fruit skewers and hummus.
Ravi: Awesome, noted. Quick housekeeping: please label controllers if they're not yours and return adapters after.
Nina: Will label. Also, can someone bring a small Bluetooth speaker for lobby music?
Sam: I have one, but battery's ~30% 90min. I'll bring it and a charger.
Olga: Vote on tournament format: react :trophy: for bracket or :crossed_swords: for free-for-all.
Nina: :crossed_swords:
Sam: :crossed_swords:
Olga: :trophy:
Ravi: Looks like free-for-all wins by count. Schedule: 7:00-7:30 setup, 7:30-9:00 casual + free-for-all matches, 9:00-10:00 indie co-op showcase, teardown after.
dev-ops-bot: Heads up: please sign the visitor log at reception and return loaned gear to the office drawer (automated reminder).
Ravi: If anyone can help haul the TV from floor 2 loading bay at 6:40 that would be hugely helpful.
Nina: I can help with the TV run at 6:35.
Sam: Ill come by at 6:30 with the Pi and speaker.
Olga: Bringing spare HDMI and a tiny extension cable.
Ravi: Thanks team 97 see you tonight. Bring a spare controller if possible and maybe an absurd hat for the championship selfie. :video_game:
